name: manyclaws
description: Connects this session to a ManyClaws server: its chat, state and approvals on one web page for every machine and account, with replies from anywhere

token.title: API token
token.description: Filled in for you as this computer is connected with the code the plugin shows in a new session. It signs this computer in, and is taken back as this computer is disconnected on your page (Account, Computers)

label.title: Label (optional)
label.description: A name for this machine or account on the web page, such as Work laptop

key.title: Encryption key
key.description: Filled in for you as this computer is connected with the code the plugin shows in a new session: there is nothing to type here. It is your account's key, written out (mcf_…), with which everything this computer's sessions say is end-to-end encrypted before it is sent. Without it nothing is sent, and the link is shown. ManyClaws has no passphrase: anything here that is not a key is no key

capabilities.title: Capabilities (optional)
capabilities.description: What the server may do here: default, all, or changes such as +files,+exec. Default: inspect, chat, notify, message, approve, upkeep (keeping this computer's plugin and agent up to date, when one of your own devices asks)
